Title: A HOLLOW TOWN

INT. MRS. MILLER'S KITCHEN - MORNING

MRS. MILLER (50s), a matriarch of a small, struggling town, is bustling around her kitchen, making breakfast for her husband, FRED (60s). She wears an apron with "World's Best Grandma" printed on it.

MRS. MILLER: (laughs) Fred, I can't believe you're still not up at sunrise.

FRED: (yawns, stretches) I'm getting old, Ruth.

INT. LIVING ROOM - LATE MORNING

Fred sits in an old rocking chair, reading the local newspaper. Mrs. Miller enters, wearing a floral print dress, with a worried look on her face.

MRS. MILLER: Fred, have you seen the latest news? Our town is in deep trouble.

FRED: (puts down the paper) What's happened now?

MRS. MILLER: (holds up the paper) The annual Hollow Town Fair was canceled due to low attendance. We need to do something.

INT. TOWN HALL - DAY

The townspeople gather in the Town Hall to discuss the canceled fair. Various concerned citizens express their thoughts and suggestions.

MAYOR JENKINS (40s): (stands, clears throat) We must find a solution to save our fair and our town.

MR. JOHNSON (50s): What about a carnival or a concert?

MRS. BAKER (30s): We could also have a bake sale.

INT. MRS. MILLER'S KITCHEN - NIGHT

Mrs. Miller and her friends, including DOTTY (70s), IRENE (30s), and VIRGINIA (40s), gather in the kitchen to plan a fundraiser.

MRS. MILLER: (wipes her forehead with an apron) I think we should host a "Great Bake-Off" competition.

DOTTY: (laughs) That's a brilliant idea, Ruth.

INT. TOWN PARK - DAY

The day of the Great Bake-Off competition arrives. Various townspeople gather in the park to watch the event. Mrs. Miller and her friends serve as judges.

MR. BAKER (60s): I've made my famous Apple Pie.

MRS. MILLER: (smiles) I can't wait to taste it, Arthur.

INT. TOWN PARK - EVENING

After a long day of baking and judging, the winners are announced. The joyous crowd cheers and celebrates. Fred and Mrs. Miller watch the excitement from the side, smiling at each other.

FRED: (proudly) I'm glad we saved our town, Ruth.

MRS. MILLER: (smiling) Together, we always find a way.

INT. TOWN HALL - NIGHT

The townspeople gather again in the Town Hall to celebrate their successful event. Fred stands at the front of the room, addressing the crowd.

FRED: (holds up a microphone) Folks, we did it! We saved our fair and our town. Let's do it again next year!

Crowd: Hollow Town, Hollow Town!

FADE OUT.
